newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Santer says EMU budget pact within reach.
newsitem.headline: Santer says EMU budget pact within reach.

text.p: The European Union is close to reaching an agreement on a budget stability pact among countries joining a common European currency, European Commission President Jacques Santer said on Wednesday.
"It is within our grasp...It must be made possible," Santer said in a speech to the European Parliament.
EU finance ministers will meet on Thursday in Dublin to hammer out remaining differences over the pact which seeks to keep public deficits within three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
A full agreement has remained elusive due to a dispute over a strict definition of the economic circumstances which would let a government inside monetary union avoid sanctions.

Germany wants an economic downturn defined numerically while others, in particular France, say it would be preferrable to have a more flexible appoach that takes account of the economic differences within EU countries.
Santer also urged EU leaders, who meet in Dublin this weekend, to step up their battle against unemployment.
"The message from Dublin must be unambiguous to make clear that the struggle against unemployment will be pursured relentlessly," Santer said.
